name: quote-of-the-day
description: A quote-of-the-day web application with random quote cycling and persistent favoriting

scripts.start: node -e "const http = require('http'), fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'); http.createServer((req, res) => { let p = path.join(__dirname, 'src', req.url === '/' ? 'index.html' : req.url); fs.readFile(p, (err, data) => { if (err) { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not Found'); } else { const ext = path.extname(p); const ct = { '.html': 'text/html', '.css': 'text/css', '.js': 'text/javascript' }[ext] || 'application/octet-stream'; res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': ct }); res.end(data); } }); }).listen(8080, () => console.log('Serving on http://localhost:8080'));"
